description: Minimal WebExtension Experiment covering the parts of Thunderbird's account model that are not (yet) available in the official MV3 API of TB 128 ESR: SMTP server enumeration, reading of file-based signatures, and creation/update of accounts. Kept intentionally small so it can be replaced by official APIs as they become available.

functions.name: listSmtpServers
functions.description: Return every outgoing (SMTP) server known to Thunderbird, in a portable-ready shape. Passwords and OAuth tokens are never returned.

functions.name: getIncomingServer
functions.description: Return the incoming-server details (hostname, port, username, socketType, authMethod, ewsUrl) for the account with the given native key. Needed because the official messenger.accounts API in TB 128+ does not expose these fields directly.

functions.name: readSignatureFile
functions.description: If the given identity uses a file-based signature (sig_file), read the file from within the Thunderbird profile and return its content plus format. Returns null if no file signature is configured. The file path itself is never exported.

functions.name: readWatchedFile
functions.description: Read a file from an absolute filesystem path (e.g. a synced Nextcloud folder). Returns null if the file does not exist. Throws on permission errors or if the file is larger than 4 MiB. Also returns mtime (ms since epoch) and a SHA-256 hex digest so callers can detect changes without re-parsing.

functions.name: writeWatchedFile
functions.description: Atomically write a UTF-8 text file to an absolute filesystem path (write to <path>.tmp then rename). Used by the optional auto-export feature to mirror the current portable configuration into a synced folder. Throws on permission errors or if the path is a directory.

functions.name: createAccount
functions.description: Create a new account (and any missing SMTP servers) from a portable account specification. Refuses accounts with type 'unsupported'. Does NOT set passwords — Thunderbird will prompt at first use.

functions.name: updateAccount
functions.description: Update an existing account in place from a portable account specification. Passwords are never touched.
